budget.monthlyHint: Maximum dollar allowance across all connected cloud model providers
budget.dailyHint: Target ceiling for total prompt and completion tokens per 24 hours

budget.hardStopHint: Halt agent invocations immediately when monthly limit is reached
budget.fallbackHint: Switch seamlessly to local $0.00 models rather than aborting active work

data.journalHint: Current transaction concurrency and recovery protocol
data.schemaHint: Applied migration version of core database tables
data.rebuildHint: Reconstruct in-memory search and message indices from event logs
data.unavailableHint: Storage details are unavailable. Check that the local database is reachable, then retry.

data.rebuildFailed: Rebuild failed. Your data is unchanged — try again.

governance.title: Security & Governance
governance.desc: Define agent autonomy thresholds, sandbox boundaries, and action approval policies.
governance.autonomyHint: Controls whether actions are carried out automatically or require interactive confirmation
governance.confirmEditsHint: Prompt for review before writing or overwriting repository source files
governance.confirmTerminalHint: Prompt before executing non-git shell commands in the workspace environment
governance.confirmPushHint: Strict human gate before pushing local commits or branch references to remote
governance.fsScopeHint: Constrain agent read and write access strictly to specified local paths
governance.blockUnsignedHint: Reject plugins lacking valid cryptographic signatures from verified publishers
governance.dataLossHint: Enforce mandatory verification before destructive SQL, cloud bucket deletions, or purge operations

info.title: About Adham
info.desc: Application build details, runtime engines, and platform diagnostics.
info.runtimeHint: Native process isolation and backend bindings
info.detailsUnavailable: Application details are unavailable. Retry from Data settings if storage is down.
info.databaseHint: Local event store and its journal mode
info.previewHint: Exactly what gets copied — versions and status only, no paths or content.
info.reportUnavailable: The diagnostic report loads with storage and platform information.
info.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the preview and copy it manually.
info.copyReportHint: Export sanitized environment info for troubleshooting

usage.title: Usage & Analytics
usage.desc: Local resource consumption metrics, token counts, and invocation breakdowns.

routing.title: Routing & Fallbacks
routing.desc: Configure model dispatch policies, latency optimization, and fallback cascades.
routing.taskHint: Assign specialized inference engines to specific agent harness task types (§8).
routing.codingHint: Fill-in-the-middle synthesis, file generation, and terminal command execution
routing.reasoningHint: Multi-step task breakdown, invariant checks, and architectural verification
routing.visionHint: Screenshot inspection, diagram parsing, and image artifact evaluation
routing.summaryHint: Session title generation, conversation memory condensation, and intent classification
routing.fallbackHint: Configure failover recovery behaviors and local privacy isolation rules.
routing.promptCloudHint: Prevent local workspace data from dispatching to third-party APIs without manual approval
routing.maxDepthHint: Number of sequential fallback engines attempted before marking the task paused
routing.dispatchHint: Define execution priority and timeout limits across local runtimes and cloud backends.
routing.strategyHint: Determine how tasks are assigned between local Ollama and cloud engines
routing.timeoutHint: Maximum elapsed time before triggering fallback or halting execution
routing.autoRetryHint: Automatically attempt secondary model when primary endpoint fails or times out
routing.streamingHint: Render partial model generations token-by-token in the chat interface
routing.footerNote: Autonomous routing guarantee: Adham honors your workspace privacy baseline and never silently charges or escalates beyond configured boundaries.
